source_or_custodian: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UNICEF, WHO, World Bank, UN Population Division); distributed via World Development Indicators (WDI) in Data360
status_or_notes: Values for 2000-2024 returned. No value for 2025 was returned by the server (latest year in the series is 2024), so 2025 is not provided. The server gave no confidence intervals. Data360 also holds a Human Capital Project indicator WB_HCP_U5MORT (under-five mortality rate, latest year 2024) that was not used. Metadata lists the series as an SDG indicator (3.2.1). Metadata also notes that IGME estimates differ by source and method, and that the series is a model-based trend estimate.
definition: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five, if subject to age-specific mortality rates of the specified year.
query_or_url: data360_get_data(database_id=WB_WDI, indicator_id=WB_WDI_SH_DYN_MORT, country_code=NGA, start_year=2000, end_year=2025); CSV: https://data360files.worldbank.org/data360-data/data/WB_WDI/WB_WDI_SH_DYN_MORT.csv
